content: Miyeꞌ pupwa ŋondolꞌme Jisas
Jisas papararme Yohe Yirise pe, kin nenge Jisas nase mih Jordan nember nal moi gungurar.
Nal moi uku pe, miyeꞌ pupwa Satan ŋondolꞌme Jisas na tatame ŋup 40. Dindiꞌ ŋup lalme luku yukur kin ŋono ŋainde, pakai. Taꞌe luku pe, nimbot ŋonombe kin pupwa supule.
Pe miyeꞌ pupwa Satan nate ŋaname na, “Ŋaiye nin Talah tikin Got pe, inime ŋeser eꞌe ka imbilme e tuꞌe kakah pe, na ono.”
Kom Jisas nungwisme na, “Wusyep sai Tup tikin Got ŋanange nange ŋai ilyehme yukur tatame ka si orpe miyeꞌ enge si, pakai.”
Miꞌe pe, miyeꞌ pupwa nenge kin nanah hwate ende pe, nilyehe sai ki ŋasambe kin moiye moiye lalme na gah kekep.

Miyeꞌ pupwa ŋaname kin na, “Ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme luku sai syep ŋam pe, ŋam tatame ŋaiye ma maŋaꞌe lahmende ŋaiye ŋam masande. Taꞌe luku pe, ŋaiye na asarꞌe ŋimbep irisukwarme ŋam pe, ma yule ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe miꞌ supule luku, topoꞌe bongol ŋaiye na embepeteme moi lalme luku.”
Kom Jisas plihe nungwisme na, “Wusyep si sai Tup tikin Got ŋanange na,

content.text: topoꞌe na orp tuwihme kin ŋilyehme.”

content: Pe miyeꞌ pupwa plihe nambaꞌe kin nenge nal Jerusalem nember kin nanah yokoh hlaꞌ tikin yukoh yirise pe, ki ŋaname na, “Ŋaiye nin Talah tikin Got pe, papalai e guh.
Wusyep sai Tup tikin Got ŋanange ŋaiye Got se ka ini lenge walip hlaꞌ kin ka yembepeteme nin bworerme.
Topoꞌe ki ŋanange ŋaiye ka se yurpe nin yenge yi yunuh hlaꞌ pe, yukur ŋeser ka gere ŋihip nin, pakai.”
Kom Jisas plihe nungwisme kin na, “Wusyep si sai Tup tikin Got ŋanange na,

content.text: ‘Yukur na se ondolꞌme Lahmborenge Got nin, pakai supule!’”

content: Ŋupe ŋaiye miyeꞌ pupwa ŋende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe luku ŋondolꞌme Jisas miꞌe pe, kin nasme Jisas nala e tutume ŋup ende ka plihe ote ondolꞌme kin.
Jisas ŋahraꞌe wah ŋendehei kin ŋanar Galili

Bongol tikin Yohe Yirise sai topoꞌe Jisas pe, ki plihe nal Galili distrik nalaŋatme lenge wusyep Got gan nato yukoh jahilyeh. Taꞌe luku pe, naŋ kin sisil nalꞌe nalꞌe noto moiye moiye luku pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme yahraꞌe naŋ kin.
Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge Nasaret jarnge Jisas

Miꞌe pe, Jisas plihe nal Nasaret, moi tiheinge kin. Nato ŋup Sabat, kin nal yokoh jahilyeh tinge taꞌe ŋaiye nye nyermbe kin nal nal. Ki tahar gan de ka gonose wusyep ende ŋaiye sai nato Tup tikin Got.
Pe miyeꞌ ende naŋaꞌe tup wusyep profet Aisaia. Ki ŋosokome tup uku pe, kin ŋetekeꞌe wusyep uku ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: “Yohe Yirise tikin Lahmborenge narp topoꞌe ŋam, taꞌe luku pe,
kin si nalaŋatme ŋam nange ma mininge wusyep bwore
Kin nember ŋam ŋaiye ma musme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge
ŋaiye yarp mwahupwaiꞌe no, ka yurp hlaininge,
topoꞌe ma mende lenge mitiŋ ŋaiye ŋembep tinge tangar ka plihe yetekeꞌe,
topoꞌe ma monombe mane ŋaiye lenge miyeꞌ yangange yalme
topoꞌe ma mininge wusyep nange ŋup si nat
ŋaiye Lahmborenge ŋoihginirme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin pe,

content: Jisas ŋupwaiꞌe tup plihe naŋaꞌe miyeꞌ uku pe, kin na gah narp. Lenge mitiŋ lalme ŋaiye yarp ya yoto yukoh jahilyeh uku bep ririrme kin sai.
Pe ki ŋana lenge na, “Wusyep Got uku ŋaiye yip si yasande pe, tukwini ŋai esep tuwei.”

Tinge ŋoihyeryembe wula wula me wusyep bwore luku ŋaiye ki ŋanange. Pe tinge yisilih yale yat na, “Hei, wusyep ŋaiye kin ŋanange bwore mise, kom kin iki talah tikin Josep. Detaꞌe lai ti kin ŋanange taꞌe luku?”

Ki ŋana lenge na, “Ŋam sisyeme, yip pa yini ŋam wusyep tap uku na, ‘Ŋaiye nin dokta pe, na ende miꞌme wahriꞌ epwa nin, topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge moi tiheinge nitei.’ Yip pa yini ŋam nange ma mende wah uku minir moi tiheinge ŋam ŋahilyeh tuꞌe ŋaiye somohonme yip si yasande ŋam mende manar Kaperneam.
Kom ŋam mana yip wusyep mise supule, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme yengelyembe wusyep lenge profet ŋupe ŋaiye tinge yanange wusyep yal moi tiheinge tinge.

Ŋoihyeryembe, ki ŋahilyeh taꞌe ŋaiye somohonme ŋupe ŋaiye ŋisih yukur gah na tatame wahtaip hun syeꞌme pe, ŋasarp sai nalꞌe nalꞌe moiye moiye. Bwore mise, dindiꞌ ŋup uku lenge tuweinge ŋope wula sekete yarp Israel, kom Got yukur nember profet Elaija nalme lenge moi jeheinge kin ŋaiye ka ungwis lenge ŋai, pakai. Kom kin nember kin nalme lenge haiten ŋaiye ka ungwisme tuwei ŋope ende ŋaiye warp moi Sarefat ŋaiye sai nato moi embere Saidon ŋilyehme.

O dindiꞌ ŋup tikin profet Elisa pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge wula nato moi tiheinge Israel yambaꞌe wahriꞌ epwa wukeh wukeh, kom yukur Elisa ŋende miꞌme wahriꞌ epwa tinge, pakai. Kom miyeꞌ ende nato moi Siria, naŋ kin Naman, kin ilyeh profet Elisa ŋende kin tahar bwore prihe.”
Ŋupe ŋaiye lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye yarp ya yoto yukoh jahilyeh yasande taꞌe luku pe, ŋoihmbwaip tinge nihe supule.
Tinge rar tahar syep yarpe Jisas pe, tinge yenge kin ya tas ŋaiye ka yiche kin yi juh hwate no, ka ole.
Kom Jisas bunjenge ŋoworꞌe bumbumbe me tinge nal pe, kin nal ko.
Jisas ginyenme yipihinge pupwa
Miꞌe pe, Jisas nate gere Kaperneam nato Galili distrik pe, ŋup tikin Sabat pe, kin nalaŋatme wusyep gan nato yukoh jahilyeh.
Pe tinge gunguru plaime wusyep kin. Detale, wusyep kin bongol ŋotohote ŋoihmbwaip tinge.
Nato yukoh jahilyeh uku miyeꞌ ende ŋaiye yipihinge pupwa si gahanahme kin narp. Pe ki tahar tambah mah na hlaꞌ na,
“Hai, Jisas miyeꞌ tikin Nasaret, detaꞌe lai ti nin nat? Nin nat ŋaiye na ende yumbun poi oho. Ŋam si sisyeme nin miyeꞌ iki. Nin miyeꞌ bwore bwarme tikin Got!”

Kom Jisas syep erŋeme kin bongol ŋaname na, “Upwaiꞌe mut, e tus osme miyeꞌ iki!” Pe yipihinge pupwa ŋiche kin na gah kekep nal bep tinge pe, ki tas nasme kin nal ko. Kom yukur yipihinge pupwa ŋende yumbune kin, pakai.

Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme gunguru plai pe, tinge yanange wusyep yale yat tititinge na, “Kii, miyeꞌ iki ŋanange wusyep bongol ŋihyele lenge yipihinge pupwa pe, tinge tas yal? Wusyep mune taꞌe liki? Bongol uku kin nambaꞌe ŋana ra?”
Taꞌe luku pe, wusyep uku sisil nalꞌe nalꞌe nato Galili distrik me wah ŋaiye Jisas ŋende.
Jisas ŋende miꞌme mamiyen tikin Saimon
Jisas nasme yukoh jahilyeh pe, kin nal yokoh Saimon. O mamiyen tikin Saimon warp yokoh uku wende wahriꞌ epwa pe, wahriꞌ ti nihe supule. Taꞌe luku pe, tinge yisilihme Jisas ŋaiye ka ungwisme ti.
Pe Jisas na gan siheime ti pe, kin ŋanange wusyep bongol me wahriꞌ epwa luku ŋaiye ka tus upwaihme ti pe, wahriꞌ epwa nasme ti ko. Miꞌe pe, ti tahar wunde ŋai me tinge.
Ŋupe ŋaiye ŋau na gah pe, lenge mitiŋ yenge lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge wahriꞌ epwa tetehei ŋaiye sai me tinge yatme Jisas pe, kin nikil syep nanah tinge lalme pe, wahriꞌ epwa tinge miꞌe.

Topoꞌe ŋupe ŋaiye kin ginyen lenge yipihinge pupwa lal tas yasme lenge mitiŋ wula wula pe, lenge yipihinge pupwa yanange na, “Hai! Nin Talah tikin Got kuli!” Kom Jisas syep erŋem lenge nange ka yupwaiꞌe mut. Detale, kin garnge ŋaiye lenge yipihinge pupwa ka yininge wusyep nange kin Miyeꞌ alaŋatme, Krais, na pakai.
Jisas ŋiche wusyep nal yukoh jahilyeh

Nyermbe hondonge pe, Jisas nasme moi uku pe, kin nal luh ŋaiye mitiŋ pakai. Kom lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge yende wah ŋaiye yekepe kin. Ŋupe ŋaiye tinge yetekeꞌe pe, tinge de ka yupwaiꞌe kin nange ka otop lenge orp. Tinge jarnge ŋaiye ka osme lenge el moi ende.
Kom ki ŋana lenge na, “Ŋam da miche wusyep bwore mise me lemame tikin Got mil moiye moiye syeꞌ topoꞌe. Leꞌe tehei kin ŋaiye Got nember ŋam nat nange ma mende.”
Taꞌe luku pe, kin nalꞌe nalꞌe moiye moiye ŋiche wusyep gan nato yukoh jahilyeh lenge Judia distrik.
